issue_context.title: Metal: Error compiling compute shader on iPhone A12

review_comments: I'm creating an empty buffer with enough data for one element, which is required for backends, like Metal, that don't support empty arrays in `struct` definitions, similar to C++.
This was incorrectly sized, so was causing validation errors when using Metal's slot-based binding API (A12 devices)
